site.name: AI Hub for Sustainable Development
site.tagline: Compute, training, funding, accelerators and partnerships for African AI innovators.
site.footer: Co-led by the Ministry of Enterprises and Made in Italy and the United Nations Development Programme.
site.curationStatement: Every resource is curated by the AI Hub team.
need.compute.def: Processing power and cloud credits to train and run your models.
need.training.def: Courses and curricula to learn and build a skill.
need.funding.def: Money to finance the work — grants, prizes and investment.
need.accelerator.def: Structured, time-bound programmes that support a venture’s growth.
need.data.def: Open datasets and benchmarks for building and evaluating AI.
need.challenges.def: Competitions and hackathons to test your skills on real problems.
need.community.def: Gatherings, chapters and events that connect the African AI community.

contact.suggestBody: Know a programme, fund, course or community that belongs in this directory? Tell us and the AI Hub team will review it. Include a link and, if you can, who it is for.

setPassword.heading: Set your password
setPassword.intro: Choose a password for your AI Hub for Sustainable Development admin account.
setPassword.policy: At least 12 characters, including a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit and a symbol.
setPassword.success: Your password is set. You can now sign in with it whenever you return.
setPassword.invalid: That password does not meet the policy: at least 12 characters, including a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a digit and a symbol.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.noSession: This link is no longer valid. Invitation and reset links can be used once and they expire. Ask an administrator for a new invitation, or request a new reset link from the sign-in screen.
forgotPassword.heading: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email address of your admin account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If that address has an admin account, a reset link is on its way. It can be used once and expires after an hour; check your spam folder if it does not arrive.

admin.import.heading: Import from the tracker
admin.import.intro: Upload the tracker’s CSV or Excel export. Every row is checked before anything is written, and rejected rows are never imported — fix them in the tracker and upload again.
admin.import.choose: Choose a CSV or Excel file
admin.import.chooseHint: CSV or Excel (.xlsx), up to {size}, {rows} rows at a time.
admin.import.pipelineNote: {count} of the passing rows are closed in the tracker, so they import as Pipeline and stay off the public directory until published.
admin.import.newPartnersNote: This import will also create {count} new provider(s): {names}
admin.import.preApprovedWarning: This file carries no Status or All Gates Passed column, so all {count} rows are being treated as approved.
admin.import.nothingToImport: No rows pass, so there is nothing to import.
admin.import.file.noDataRows: No data rows found — export the tracker with a header row.
admin.import.file.missingColumns: Missing required tracker columns: {columns}. Export the tracker with its standard headers.
admin.import.file.tooManyRows: That file has more than {limit} rows. Split it and import the parts separately.
admin.import.file.tooManyNewPartners: That file would create more than {limit} new providers, which usually means the Provider column is mis-mapped.
admin.import.file.tooLarge: That file is larger than {size}. Export only the rows you need.
admin.import.file.unreadable: That file could not be read. Export it again as CSV or .xlsx and retry.
admin.import.reject.notApproved: Status is “{detail}” — only Published or Approved rows import.
admin.import.reject.unknownCategory: Category “{detail}” does not map to a directory category.
admin.import.reject.missingSummary: No summary to use as the description.
admin.import.reject.insecureLink: Link is not https ({detail}) — fix it in the tracker.
admin.import.reject.badDeadline: Closing date “{detail}” is not in YYYY-MM-DD format.
admin.import.reject.possibleDuplicate: Looks like the existing “{detail}” — add it with the resource form if it is genuinely different.
admin.import.reject.duplicateInFile: This file already has a row for “{detail}”.
admin.import.reject.invalid: Row does not fit the resource format ({detail}).
admin.resources.deleteBlocked: This resource cannot be deleted while a submission refers to it. Reject or resolve that submission in the Review Queue first.

admin.audit.intro: A read-only record of who did what. No entry here can be edited or deleted.

admin.settings.heading: Settings
admin.settings.intro: Analytics, team access, the contact mailbox and the home page welcome band. Edits apply immediately, no rebuild.
admin.settings.ga4.eventsNote: Once set, the public site loads GA4 and fires pageviews plus custom events: resource_view, apply_click, search_performed, filter_used, export_clicked. Search impressions live in Google Search Console and paid or social reach in the ad platforms — separate sources that can be added later; they are not part of GA4.
admin.settings.ga4.invalidMeasurementId: Must be empty, or a Measurement ID in the form G-XXXXXXXXXX.
admin.settings.contact.note: Fixed to the one AI Hub mailbox; no other address is accepted.
